questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: You can do it online and it goes very fast.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: You sign up for courses at UGLA and it just takes a few clicks. You can change it if you want.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: You can reach out and ask the study centre if you need help.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Very successful.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Just to it. No advice required.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Super cool and practical. Feels like you can actual use it in real life.

questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: It was good. Quite chill and not very difficult. You are just kept quite busy with group work and hand ins. That was a bit annoying.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Very similar, just smaller class rooms. Feels practical with group work.

questions.answer: Nothing much at the university but you can find them through groups and chats organised by the host university.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Hot Dogs, Ice cream and pools. They just feel very Icelandic.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Do day trips and try to see the whole island. Its great.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Very easy. Hardest is to adjust to the darkness and changes of sun light. But that is a fun experience.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: You will meet the on the way, Stick to exchange students and try to look for local students on the way or in classes.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: None

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: All of it. Folk music is really cool in Iceland. Very fun language for music.

questions.answer: go out, spend the money and go on that trip you thought of. Its worth it.
